original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_CEMBB as the approved board-level CEMBB temperature channel, proving exact assembly/probe identity and consistent name, description, reading and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The platform/thermal owner defines CEMBB, identifies assembly revision and probe coordinate, states whether it represents board hotspot or local airflow, supplies condition-specific limits, and automation performs passive complete cross-path collection.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner defines CEMBB, maps the exact assembly and probe, approves sensor meaning, limits and Web entry. No card/board service, load or airflow change is authorized.
required_inputs: Authoritative CEMBB meaning and assembly PN/revision
Exact probe coordinate relative to slots, connectors, airflow and board heat sources
Sensor source and measurement role as board hotspot, component proxy or air temperature
Expected SDR name/entity/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges/states under documented card population, link/load, cooling and ambient conditions
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/CEMBB/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Do not infer CEMBB expansion or physical meaning from the label alone
Bind the record to assembly revision and exact probe/source location
Prove same-target IB/OOB and retain complete inventories before filtering
Keep CEMBB distinct from CEMSlot1 and CEMSlot2; do not reuse their limits
Do not service cards/board, create workload, alter airflow/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, cross-path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, owner-defined CEMBB topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact CEMBB record
Prepare Web evidence and passive population/load/fan/ambient/SEL context
Perform no board/card/load/airflow/threshold action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define CEMBB and approve assembly/probe/source mapping
Confirm Web mapping and cross-path parity
Review board-level evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only the exact OOB query is relevant; it omits IB, full Sensor List and Web, truncates SDR and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List, extract the owner-mapped CEMBB record and compare Web evidence under documented population/load/airflow.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_CEMBB, four command views, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; acronym meaning, coordinate and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES CEMBB ASSEMBLY/PROBE MAP, THERMAL CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the record to a versioned assembly and physical probe/source, then reconcile complete IB/OOB raw data with Web evidence under known platform conditions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds owner-controlled naming, assembly/probe provenance, measurement-role semantics and same-target parity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CEM slot-zone sensors or one OOB exact result cannot establish this board-level channel across all required views.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A shared board probe can smooth local slot hotspots; conversely a component-adjacent probe can exceed air-temperature limits while the system remains healthy.

project_override_considerations: Board revisions that relocate the probe or change card population require versioned mappings and limits. If CEMBB is a derived aggregate rather than a physical probe, the aggregation inputs, window and coverage must be documented explicitly.
expected_evidence: Owner-defined CEMBB assembly PN/revision and probe/source coordinate
Measurement-role semantics, SDR/entity/description and Web mapping
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Cross-path record identity/value/state parity with units/freshness/limits
BMC Web entry and passive population/load/fan/ambient/SEL context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets one CEMBB temperature channel across IB/OOB and Web. Undefined acronym, physical mapping and limits are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive board-level thermal check is identifiable; CEMBB definition, assembly/probe mapping and criteria are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Keeps CEMBB meaning owner-controlled, adds assembly/probe and measurement-role provenance, restores complete cross-path evidence and excludes adjacent slot-zone substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Board-level thermal sensors often sit near connectors, regulators or recirculation zones rather than measuring an average board temperature. Revision changes can move the probe while retaining the firmware label. Exact assembly and coordinate binding therefore govern the valid threshold set, and slot sensors cannot replace this channel because they observe different local heat paths.
